description: A sample taxonomy to start from: two modes in two groups. Replace it with yours, and say in maps_to which regex_v1 mode each of yours corresponds to.

groups.name: Unanswered
groups.definition: Something a post asks for never comes back.

groups.name: Unbacked
groups.definition: A post states something that a reader cannot check from the board.

modes.name: Open question
modes.definition: The post asks a question that no later post answers or cites.

modes.name: Bare claim
modes.definition: The post says something is done or passes, and names no file, item or post a reader could check.
